items.prompt: A job has one unit remaining and the quantum is 5. How much elapsed time does its final turn add?

options.why: The charged service is min(quantum, remaining), not a padded full quantum.
The unused portion of the final quantum is not charged.
The final unit still requires service.
Adding both the quantum and remaining work double counts service.
